q: Dark moths rose quickly from about 2% to 98%.
Explain the rise using natural selection.
Soot made bark dark; dark moths were camouflaged, so birds ate fewer; they survived and reproduced, passing on dark colour.
Clean air laws were passed in 1956. Use the data to explain what happened next.
Bark became pale again, so pale moths were camouflaged and dark ones eaten: dark moths fell to about 2% by 2010.
